context: After taking this walk, the person is now 10.0 km east and 5.0 km north of the B point of origin. The resultant displacement is represented by the arrow labeled DR in Fig. 3-3. (The subscript R stands for resultant.) Using a ruler and a protractor, you can measure on this diagram that the person is 11.2 km from the origin at an angle u = 27° north of east. In other words, the resultant displacement vector has a magnitude of 11.2 km and makes an angle u = 27° with the positive x axis. The B magnitude (length) of DR can also be obtained using the theorem of Pythagoras
